name: Crash Recovery & Automation Queue Reconciliation
changes: Prevents Continuous Automation from overfilling its configured queue after a Windows/app restart while the private SAB queue/history is still being reconstructed.

Reconciles crash-recovered completed SAB History jobs against the authoritative media library when their original Completed Download Folder was already cleaned by a successful pre-crash Smart Import, clearing false Import Failed cards without moving or deleting media.

Rechecks authoritative live Automation occupancy immediately before every automatic Grab, so jobs recovered during a long-running cycle consume queue capacity immediately instead of only being noticed at cycle completion.

Recovers the narrow state where the global NewzDeck queue is unpaused but the sole adopted/recovered SAB queue job is individually Paused, while persisting future per-job user pause intent so explicit pauses are not overridden.

Defers unattended grabbing while the private download engine is not probe-ready, and shortens only the expected service-before-tray startup race retry from 90 seconds to 8 seconds without rotating SAB identity or deleting queue state.
regression_guards: Recovered-import reconciliation is fail-closed: only adopted SAB jobs with recovered exact Automation context, missing-media intent, an on-disk exact library target, and equal-or-better authoritative quality are accepted.
Existing/recovered SAB jobs are never cancelled, removed, reordered, or redownloaded by this fix; only new unattended Automation admission and the narrow sole-job resume recovery are affected.
Manual Search/Grab, Newznab matching/scoring, normal Smart Import, no-downgrade and target-integrity validation remain on their accepted paths.
v3.6.37 operation activity feedback, v3.6.36 Automation action wiring, and v3.6.35 Manual Import live progress remain required production markers.
Release-blocking tests cover restart queue occupancy and recovered completed-import reconciliation.
